content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

For building muscle, aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight per day. Research shows benefits plateau around 1.6 g/kg, and the higher end is useful if you're in a calorie deficit or want a safety margin. 💪 Spread it over 3–5 meals with roughly 0.3–0.4 g/kg each, and make sure your total calories are enough. Protein alone won't build the bench press, so eat to support your 100 kg goal!
